name: Williamson–Hall plot with linear fit
use_case: Crystallite size (intercept) and microstrain (slope) from peak broadening.
origin_hint: Origin: Scatter + Analysis > Fitting > Linear Fit; report table to sheet.
calculations: linear regression: slope = strain, intercept = Kλ/D (K, λ user-confirmed)
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
